column5: The implementation of GHG reduction targets can reinforce biodiversity protection and conservation efforts by reducing pollution and promoting sustainable land use, which in turn can help protect and restore ecosystems and biodiversity.
Reducing GHG emissions can enable the restoration of terrestrial ecosystems by promoting sustainable land use and reducing the impact of climate change on ecosystems.
GHG reduction can aid in the restoration of marine ecosystems by mitigating the effects of ocean acidification and promoting sustainable fishing and aquaculture practices.
The transition to renewable energy sources can be facilitated by reducing GHG emissions, which in turn can enable the implementation of renewable energy targets and promote energy efficiency.
Reducing GHG emissions can reinforce energy efficiency efforts by promoting the use of renewable energy sources and reducing energy consumption, which can help achieve energy efficiency targets.

GHG reduction can enable energy efficiency in buildings by promoting the use of renewable energy sources and reducing energy consumption, which can help achieve building-related energy efficiency targets.

The protection and conservation of biodiversity can be indivisibly linked to the restoration of terrestrial ecosystems, as preserving biodiversity is essential for maintaining ecosystem services and promoting ecological restoration.

Biodiversity protection and conservation efforts can reinforce the restoration of agricultural ecosystems by promoting sustainable agricultural practices and reducing the use of harmful pesticides and fertilizers.
The conservation of biodiversity can aid in the restoration of forests by promoting sustainable forestry practices and reducing deforestation, which can help protect and restore forest ecosystems.

Biodiversity conservation efforts can reinforce marine ecosystem restoration by promoting sustainable fishing and aquaculture practices and reducing pollution, which can help protect and restore marine ecosystems.

The conservation of biodiversity in fisheries can enable the implementation of solar energy targets by promoting sustainable fishing practices and reducing the environmental impact of the fishing industry.
The monitoring of biodiversity can aid in the implementation of renewable energy targets in the heating and cooling sector by promoting sustainable and energy-efficient practices.
The restoration of terrestrial ecosystems can enable the implementation of renewable energy targets by promoting sustainable land use and reducing the environmental impact of energy production.
The restoration of agricultural ecosystems can aid in achieving energy efficiency targets by promoting sustainable agricultural practices and reducing energy consumption.
The restoration of rivers can enable the implementation of hydrogen production targets by promoting sustainable water management practices and reducing the environmental impact of energy production.

The restoration of marine ecosystems can enable the implementation of solar energy targets by promoting sustainable fishing and aquaculture practices and reducing pollution.
Biodiversity conservation efforts can reinforce social security and energy targets by promoting sustainable and equitable energy access and reducing energy poverty.
